name: RB-Y1
def: Wheeled two armed humanoid manipulator sold as a development platform, notable for a six axis body that raises and leans the torso while driving.
body: RB-Y1 is 1.4 metres tall in its neutral pose, weighs 131 kilograms and combines two seven axis arms with a six axis torso on a two wheel balancing base. The torso lets it change working height by more than 50 centimetres and lean into turns, so it can pick from the floor and from a high shelf without a lift column. Each arm carries three kilograms and the base moves at up to 2.5 metres per second. Rainbow Robotics, in which Samsung Electronics took a controlling stake, sells it with a development kit to companies building manipulation and embodied learning applications.
facts: Presented in April 2024 as Korea's first bimanual mobile manipulator of its type
Torso axes change working height by more than 50 centimetres
Samsung Electronics became the controlling shareholder of Rainbow Robotics
specs: Two seven axis electric arms on a six axis torso and two wheel balancing base
Head and wrist cameras with joint encoders and IMU
Supplied development kit for building manipulation and learning applications
